name: GitHub Security Advisory Ingestion Stopped
description: Generates an alert when one or more GitHub security advisory streams (reviewed, unreviewed, malware) have ingested no documents for 26 hours. Each stream polls every 24 hours, so a longer gap means the Elastic Agent, its CEL input, or the output to Elasticsearch has stopped.
query:
FROM logs-github.security_advisories-default
| EVAL all_tags = MV_CONCAT(tags, ",")
| STATS reviewed = COUNT(*) WHERE all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-reviewed*",
        unreviewed = COUNT(*) WHERE all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-unreviewed*",
        malware = COUNT(*) WHERE all_tags LIKE "*github-security-advisories-malware*"
| EVAL advisory_ingestion.silent_streams = REPLACE(TRIM(CONCAT(CASE(reviewed == 0, "reviewed ", ""), CASE(unreviewed == 0, "unreviewed ", ""), CASE(malware == 0, "malware", ""))), " +", ", ")
| WHERE advisory_ingestion.silent_streams != ""
| KEEP advisory_ingestion.silent_streams
false_positives: Planned Agent maintenance or a stack restart longer than two hours past a scheduled poll.
note:
## Triage and analysis

- Check that the `github_security_advisories` Agent container is running and review its logs for CEL or output errors.
- Check the **GitHub Security Advisory Ingestion Errors** rule for collection or pipeline errors on the same streams.
- Restarting the Agent triggers an immediate poll.

While streams stay silent the rule matches every hour; alerts are suppressed per set of silent streams for 24 hours, giving one reminder per day.
setup: Requires the `github_security_advisories` standalone configuration from this repository, which tags each advisory stream with `github-security-advisories-<type>`. The data stream must exist (the Agent creates it on its first poll).
